newsitem.title: USA: Santander-Chile sees Osorno loan review end.
newsitem.headline: Santander-Chile sees Osorno loan review end.

text.p: Banco Santander-Chile said it expected to complete its review of former Banco Osorno's loan portfolio by the end of June 1997 and did not expect future related charges to exceed US$7 million.
Banco Santander-Chile was formed in mid-1996 by the merger of Banco Santander and Banco Osorno y L Union.
In the first quarter, the bank had non-recurring charges of 4.3 billion pesos or $10.4 million related to this loan-by-loan review, it said.
Santander-Chile said in evaluating Osorno's loans, it was analyzing cash flow instead of relying on the existence of collateral, as Osorno's former management had.
